title: Barcelona forward using the international break to reach full fitness and adapt to Flick’s style
tweet: Jesus scored twice in 41 minutes across four games after arriving for €10 m. He is using the international break to match Flick’s high‑intensity demands rather than take a week off. As things stand, the 29‑year‑old’s fitness work should see him fully integrated when the eight‑game run resumes.

title: Espanyol winger Bryan Zaragoza reveals he could have joined Barcelona: ‘There were contacts’
tweet: Bryan Zaragoza confirmed there were contacts about a move to Barça, but nothing was finalised. As things stand, the link remains a footnote in his career, not a turning point. The reality is the move never progressed beyond conversations.
